title: CapEx-OpEx blended deployment sandbox
body:
Purpose and context:
This is a sandbox spreadsheet-style doc for exploring blended CapEx / OpEx models for private deployments (on-prem racks, colo/VPC-managed, hybrid burst). The goal is to produce knobs and clear outputs for sales + bizops to: (a) recommend licensing + support bundles that match customer cost targets, (b) show amortized unit costs under different demand profiles, and (c) make quick sensitivity slides for deal review.

Status: rough draft. Not customer-facing. Use for internal pricing experiments and to seed the formal TCO workbook.

High-level approach (summary):
- Capture three cost buckets: upfront CapEx, recurring OpEx, and service/license fees.
- Amortize CapEx over configurable periods (3, 4, 5 years) with two depreciation shapes (straight-line, stepped refresh).
- Model varying utilization profiles: steady (70%), seasonal (40%->90%), and bursty (baseline 30% + burst capacity).
- Include quantization/optimization savings (lower GPU count, reduced memory footprint) as a percentage multiplier on CapEx and per-token OpEx.
- Output: cost per 1k tokens, cost per concurrent request, and blended monthly unit price with recommended license/support mix.

Key inputs (spreadsheet inputs sheet):
- Assumptions (editable):
  - target_qps_peak: 1200 (requests/sec)
  - avg_seq_length: 256 tokens
  - tokens_per_request: 350
  - throughput_per_gpu_baseline: 1200 tokens/s (64-bit fp baseline)
  - gpu_cost_onprem_per_unit: $18,000
  - rack_overhead_per_gpu: $1,200 (network, power share, racking)
  - network_switch_cost_per_rack: $6,000
  - colo_power_per_month_per_rack: $900
  - infra_admin_fte_pct: 0.15 (percentage of an SRE FTE allocated)
  - fte_loaded_cost: $190,000/year
  - support_tier_multiplier: {"standard": "1.0", "enterprise": "1.45", "platinum": "1.9"}
  - license_base_per_gpu_per_year: $9,600
  - quantization_savings_pct: 0.28 (reduces required GPUs by this percent)
  - amortization_years: 4
  - cloud_vpc_monthly_base: $2,500 (base network, endpoints)
  - cloud_egress_per_tb: $90
  - expected_egress_tb_per_month: 8

Sizing model (rough formulas / notes):
- effective_throughput_per_gpu = throughput_per_gpu_baseline * (1 + optimization_factor) * (1 - quantization_savings_pct)
- required_gpus = CEILING((tokens_per_second_needed) / effective_throughput_per_gpu)
  where tokens_per_second_needed = target_qps_peak * avg_seq_length
- onprem_total_hardware_cost = required_gpus * (gpu_cost_onprem_per_unit + rack_overhead_per_gpu) + network_switch_cost_per_rack * CEILING(required_gpus / GPUs_PER_RACK)
- monthly_depreciation = onprem_total_hardware_cost / (12 * amortization_years) for straight-line
- recurring_op_ex_onprem_monthly = colo_power_per_month_per_rack * CEILING(required_gpus / GPUs_PER_RACK) + (infra_admin_fte_pct * fte_loaded_cost / 12) + ops_license_and_monitoring
- vpc_monthly_estimate = cloud_vpc_monthly_base + (expected_egress_tb_per_month * cloud_egress_per_tb) + (runtime_cost_per_token * estimated_tokens_per_month)

Sensitivity slice setup (what to vary):
- amortization_years: 3, 4, 5
- quantization_savings_pct: 0.0, 0.15, 0.28, 0.45
- support_tier_multiplier: standard / enterprise / platinum
- utilization: 30% baseline, 50%, 70%, 90%
- refresh pattern: immediate full refresh every N years vs 20% rolling per year

Preliminary outputs (example numbers - placeholder, update after running the sheet):
- Example scenario A (steady 70%, quant 28%, amort 4y):
  - required_gpus: 24
  - onprem_hardware_capex: $468,000
  - monthly_amortization: $9,750
  - recurring_onprem_ops: $16,400/month (power, SRE allocation, monitoring, network)
  - license_support_annual (standard): $230,400 ($9,600 * 24)
  - blended_total_monthly (incl license support amortized): $28,500 => implied cost per 1k tokens: $0.67 (placeholder)

- Example scenario B (hybrid burst: base 30% onprem, burst to 100% cloud for 2h/day):
  - onprem_required_gpus: 9 (handles baseline)
  - cloud_burst_gpu_hours_per_month: 2h/day * 30 days * cloud_gpu_count_for_peak_equiv
  - blended_monthly: onprem amort + burst cloud spend + support = $19,300 => cost per 1k tokens: $0.81 (placeholder)

Interpretation notes and heuristics for sales bundles:
- For customers with predictable high utilization (>70%) onprem amortization usually wins after 18–24 months if contract length >= 3 years. Recommend a bundled discount on license (10–15%) that unlocks a 24-month ROI justification slide.
- For bursty workloads, propose a hybrid bundle: smaller onprem footprint (capex reduction) + pre-purchased burst credits (cloud) at a committed discount. Structure: base license at 0.65x price, plus burst credits at 0.75x on-demand.
- For regulated customers with attention to audit logs and slower refresh cycles, offer extended amortization pricing (5-year) with a reduced annual license escalation to make ARR smoother.

Open questions / TODOs (notes-to-self style):
- Need validated baseline throughput numbers for our quantized kernels on A100 vs newer Ampere-X variants. Ping: @Ethan to provide microbench matrix (GH PR link above).
- Confirm GPUs_PER_RACK assumption: spreadsheet currently uses 8; some partners can fit 10–12 with 2U form factors. Update when infra team confirms.
- Add a simple NPV calculation for multi-year payments and include discount rate (8% / 12% scenarios).
- Build a chart that shows crossover point months between onprem vs VPC at different utilization bands (automate in the sheet).

Recommended next steps (short list):
1) Convert inputs here into the canonical private-deployments TCO workbook as a new sheet (owner: Maya).
2) Get infra perf numbers and plug into throughput_per_gpu_baseline and quantization multipliers (owner: Ethan).
3) Run batch of sensitivity sweeps (amortization x quantization x utilization) and export top 3 recommended bundles for deals > $200k ARR (owner: Ravi).
4) Draft two one-pagers for sales: (a) steady-high-utilization onprem playbook, (b) hybrid burst credit offer.

Quick scratch calculations (manual checks):
- tokens_per_second_needed example: 1200 qps * 256 = 307,200 tokens/s. With effective_throughput_per_gpu ~ 20,000 tokens/s => ~16 GPUs required (pre-quant). After quantization 28% -> 12 GPUs.
- Annual license on 12 GPUs at $9,600 = $115,200; if license is bundled at 0.9 -> $103,680.

Slack and comms notes: link initial ask thread: slack://team-product/channels/pd-costs?thread=Q2-deploy-costs (placeholder).

Versioning / provenance: created from internal brainstorm with product + solutions-eng (Feb 2025). This doc is intentionally loose — canonical numbers must come from infra perf team and finance sign-off before customer use.

If you edit the sheet: highlight any assumption changes in yellow and add your initials + date on the header row.

End of sandbox doc.
